verbatim.depth1_time: average depth-1 time ... 55 ms per layer (98-qubit random layer incl. sort)
verbatim.memory_error: linear memory error rate of 5(1)x10^-4 per depth-1 time
verbatim.parallel_two_qubit_operations: 2Q operations are executed in only four of the eight quantum logic zones
verbatim.programs: Guppy/HUGR; Pytket can be submitted to Helios by loading the user circuit into Guppy source

verbatim.data_sheet: H1 data sheet URL returned 404 on 2026-10-02

verbatim.emulator_linear_dephasing_rate: 0.0028 /s (H2 emulator data sheet v1.2, H2-1 defaults, 2024)

t_round_reasons.low: 70 us gate + ~300 us post-shift cooling + short transport (Helios paper Sec. II.3)
t_round_reasons.mid: 55 ms / 49 gates: the Helios full-register random layer per gate
t_round_reasons.high: 55 ms / (49/4) rounds: one round of a full random layer incl. the sort

memory_model.memory_rate_inputs: Helios 5e-4 per 55 ms layer (arXiv:2511.05465); H2-1 emulator linear dephasing 0.0028 /s; H2-2 and H1-1 scaled by the performance-validation memory errors 1.2e-4 / 2.0e-4 and 2.2e-4 / 2.0e-4
memory_model.rounds_rule: rounds = max(ceil(n_2q / parallel zones), two-qubit critical-path depth)
memory_model.S_idle: S_idle = n_qubits x rounds x t_round x rate;  f_with_memory = f_gate_only x exp(-S_idle)

billing.formula: HQC = 5 + C (N_1q + 10 N_2q + 5 N_m) / 5000 per job
billing.N_m: initialisations + measurements (= 2 x n_qubits for one measurement per qubit)
billing.syntax_checkers: Syntax Checkers usage is offered free-of-charge (Azure provider page)

azure_plans.pay_as_you_go: per HQC usage, rate by contact

usd_per_hqc_ESTIMATE.label: Azure-Standard-equivalent (USD 125,000 / 10,000 HQC); the pay-as-you-go and research rates are not public

verbatim.deadline: monthly; request by the 25th of the preceding month
verbatim.eligibility: US national labs, universities, government, and industry; quantinuum.com: Researchers in the United States may apply
